resources.string: The language changes when you save. Your website address and custom text are kept.
Returning here with Home means this app is the launcher. Full Android lock also requires Device Owner and an active lock task.
Remove the Android screen lock first.
"Choose a 6–12 digit admin PIN. It is required to change settings or exit the kiosk. There is no default PIN or recovery code."
"Keep your PIN somewhere safe before continuing."
"Could not save the PIN. Try again."
"We are glad to see you here"
"Your personal PIN protects settings and exit."
"Choose what appears on the home screen. Settings require your PIN each time and close after 3 minutes of inactivity."
"● Device Owner active · lock not currently active"
"○ Full Android lock is not active · Device Owner setup required"
"Allow navigation only on the same domain (recommended)"
"If sign-in uses another domain, you can disable this restriction. External apps, downloads, pop-ups and file uploads are blocked."
"Enter a complete, valid address starting with https://"
"Display saved. Full lock requires Device Owner."

"The tablet will always open the kiosk. Home, Recents, notifications and USB debugging will be blocked. For settings, tap ⋮, choose Kiosk settings and enter your PIN. Make sure you have saved your PIN."

"Install the APK on a device without accounts or another device manager. On a computer with ADB:

adb shell dpm set-device-owner il.co.kiosk/.KioskAdminReceiver

Then reopen the app, enter your PIN and save settings to enable the lock. USB debugging is disabled while locked.

Tap ⋮ in the top-right corner, choose Kiosk settings, then enter your PIN.

Android access is for supervised maintenance. Returning to the kiosk or rebooting locks it again.

There is no recovery PIN. A recovery reset can erase all data. The app starts after power-on; it cannot power on a switched-off device."
"This signs you out of websites and clears cookies and local storage."
"Kiosk lock and automatic launch will be disabled, and the app can be uninstalled. Restoring full management requires setup through a computer again."
"Enter a valid new PIN and matching confirmation."
"The current PIN is incorrect or access is paused. Try again later."
